height_rationale: Greybox hero in crates/gf_client/src/scene.rs spawn_rig: capsule body to 1.70 m + head sphere at 1.82 m with radius r*0.62 = 0.32 m for Brax (stats.radius 0.52), i.e. top at 2.14 m. The roster range is 2.0-2.3 m; Brax is the bulky brawler but not the biggest hero (Valdris, radius 0.55, is the juggernaut), so 2.2 m: +3 % over the greybox top, T-pose span 2.69 m, torso half-width 0.29 m ~ his 0.52 m collision radius with the arms in. Meltdown scales him x1.25 to 2.75 m.
units: metres, Blender axes: Z up, hero faces -Y, +X = his left, feet on z = 0
source: measured on art/characters/brax/work/brax_retopo_start.blend (REF_blockout = TRELLIS s202 normalised to 2.2 m) and the approved front concept

landmarks._doc: MakeHuman (MPFB game_engine rig, T-posed) landmark -> Brax position. '<bone>.head' / '<bone>.tail' are joint positions, other keys are surface points recorded by s2_body_base.py. _l entries are mirrored to _r automatically.

fit._doc: Surface fit of the warped body to REF_blockout. Bands are z ranges (m); weight 0 keeps the warped MakeHuman shape (hidden or covered by a separate mesh). inset pulls the target inside the blockout surface by that many metres (room for wraps / straps). contain: keep the body at least this far inside the blockout (skull under hair, jaw under beard). Under the skirt the warped MakeHuman hips/thighs are kept as they are (the blockout's thighs there are internal generator shells). In a band with contain > 0, sculpt points that sample dark (hair/beard) are containment targets instead of fit targets. y_min: vertices in front of that y (m) get no fit in the band (the throat under the beard follows its neighbours). ignore_dark: dark sculpt points (the beard's underside over the upper chest) are never targets in that band; used only there because TRELLIS's baked shadows make some skin dark too.

rigid._doc: Near-rigid regions: fitted with a per-axis scale + translation (weighted least squares) instead of per-vertex, so the face loops, ears and toes keep the base topology's shape. z_min/z_max = region edge, ramp = blend distance into the free-form body fit (m). Head: face skin with y < face_front_y is pulled onto the sculpt; skull and jaw under hair/beard are kept `contain` m inside it; already-deep points hold with keep_weight. mode landmarks_only: the head keeps the landmark warp (head.head, skull_top, ear, skull_back, chin, eyes, nose) and is not surface-fitted; the TRELLIS face is too soft to fit per vertex.

post_smooth._doc: Laplacian smoothing after the fit in a box (softens the step where the fitted trapezius meets the unfitted throat; the beard covers the rest).

extra_loops._doc: knee: one loop through the joint and one each side (the reduced hm08 leg has a ring every ~6 cm)

fit._doc_arms: 2026-09-25 user decision: weapons are separate models, so the body keeps bare forearms and hands (no cut). The sculpt's forearms are gauntlet there, so forearms/hands are landmark-warped only and thickened radially (limb_radial); wrist at 0.925 m and fingertips at 1.176 m give a 0.25 m heroic hand (0.114 of the height, MakeHuman's own ratio).

limb_radial._doc: Bare forearms/hands (the sculpt has gauntlets there): the arm cross-section around the arm axis (y=axis_y, z=axis_z) is scaled per x-slab so its mean radius follows radius_m (brawler forearms: 0.105 m at the elbow to 0.058 m at the wrist); past hand_from_abs_x the hand is scaled by hand_scale.

hand_frame._doc: weapon attach frame per hand (stage 3 adds weapon_L / weapon_R sockets here): origin = palm centre (mean of the hand vertices between the wrist joint and the knuckle line), +Y along the fingers, +Z out of the back of the hand, +X = Y x Z.

base._doc: MPFB (tool only) macro sliders and CC0 MakeHuman targets applied before baking: a heavy, angular heroic face (square jaw, heavy brow ridge, strong nose, stern mouth) like the approved concept.
